jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Healthcare Project Manager to lead and coordinate healthcare projects from initiation through completion. The ideal candidate will manage project planning, stakeholder communication, budgets, timelines, risk management, and cross-functional teams while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations and organizational goals.
 
Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, monitor, and close healthcare projects within scope, schedule, and budget. 
Develop project plans, timelines, resource allocation, and project documentation. 
Coordinate with clinical, operational, IT, and business stakeholders. 
Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies. 
Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to leadership. 
Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, quality standards, and organizational policies. 
Manage project budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement activities. 
Facilitate meetings, prepare reports, and maintain project documentation. 
Lead change management initiatives and support user adoption. 
Track project KPIs and recommend process improvements. 
Resolve project issues and escalate critical concerns when necessary. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Nursing, Information Technology, or a related field. 
5–8 years of project management experience, preferably in healthcare. 
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously. 
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid). 
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. 
Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, or Monday.com. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, or related field). 
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification. 
Experience with Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR) implementations. 
Knowledge of healthcare regulations such as HIPAA (or applicable regional healthcare compliance requirements).

jobs.title: Test Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview
Engagement Details

Duration: 9 months
Start: Immediate
Location: [Onsite – Irvine, CA or Portland, OR ]
Extension: Possible based on program needs

Need local consultants 
Client  is seeking an experienced Test Manager to lead and drive end-to-end testing.
This is a contractor role responsible for establishing, managing, and executing the overall testing strategy across a complex, multi-system environment. The Test Manager will partner closely with Global IT, business stakeholders, PMO, and Testing-as-a-Service (TaaS) teams to ensure high-quality delivery, governance, and readiness for deployment.
The role requires strong leadership across System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression and readiness cycles, ensuring alignment with defined entry/exit criteria, defect thresholds, and governance expectations.


Key Responsibilities
1. Test Strategy Execution & Leadership

Lead execution of the Project Testing Strategy, ensuring alignment with program objectives, scope, and governance.
Drive testing across all phases:

·        



System Integration Testing (SIT1, SIT2)
User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
User Dress Rehearsal (UDR)
Regression testing 


Ensure risk-based testing prioritization, focused on critical business processes, integrations, and controls.



2. Test Planning & Governance

Develop and govern detailed test plans, schedules, and execution models aligned with the integrated program plan.
Define and enforce entry/exit criteria, readiness checkpoints, and test cycles.
Ensure complete requirements traceability (RTM) and coverage of all business processes.
Work with PMO to establish and maintain RACI, reporting cadence, and governance forums.



3. Cross-System Integration Testing Oversight

Lead testing across a complex application landscape, including:

·        



SAP S/4HANA
Salesforce
Kinaxis
Hyperion / Anaplan
Ariba
Other enterprise and homegrown applications


Ensure validation of:

·        



End-to-end business processes
Data migration, reconciliation, and conversion
Interfaces (inbound/outbound)
Security roles and controls
Reporting and analytics





4. Test Execution Management

Oversee test execution using qTest ALM for:

·        



Test planning and repository management
Script execution tracking
Defect lifecycle management
Reporting and dashboards


Coordinate with  Global TaaS teams, SMEs, and IT delivery teams for smooth execution.
Ensure test scripts are designed, reviewed, approved, and executed with proper evidence.



5. Defect & Quality Management

Own defect triage, prioritization, and resolution governance.
Ensure defects are tracked, categorized, and resolved within thresholds:

·        



No critical/high defects at phase exit
Defined pass-rate thresholds (e.g., 90–95% for SIT, 100% for UAT)


Drive root cause analysis and regression validation.
Provide daily defect and testing status reporting to leadership.



6. Business Engagement & UAT Leadership

Partner with business stakeholders to:

·        



Define UAT scope and scenarios
Support business testers during execution
Ensure complete validation of business processes


Drive UAT sign-off and deployment readiness decisions.



7. Environment & Data Readiness

Ensure readiness of:

·        



Test environments (SIT, UAT, Dress Rehearsal)
Test data (mock cutovers, converted data)


Coordinate environment dependencies and readiness milestones with IT and PMO.



8. Reporting & Executive Communication

Provide daily/weekly test status reporting, including:

·        



Execution progress
Defect metrics
Risk and issue tracking


Present updates to senior leadership and governance forums.
Escalate risks proactively with mitigation plans.



Required Qualifications
Experience

12+ years of experience in enterprise application testing/programs
8+ years hands on Test Manager / Test Lead roles
Proven experience leading testing for large-scale ERP transformations or integrations
Strong experience with multi-system integration programs
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

Functional & Technical Expertise

Deep understanding of:

·        



SAP S/4HANA testing
Enterprise SaaS platforms (Salesforce, Ariba, Anaplan, Kinaxis)


Experience in: 

·        



End-to-end business process testing (OTC, P2P, SCM, Finance, etc.)
Data migration and reconciliation validation
Interface and integration testing





Testing Tools & Methodologies

Hands-on experience with:

·        



qTest (Highly preferred) or similar ALM tools


Strong expertise in:

·        



Test lifecycle management
Defect management frameworks
Requirements traceability
Risk-based testing





Leadership & Soft Skills

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience working with:

·        



Global teams
Business SMEs
IT delivery and PMO organizations


Excellent communication and executive presentation skills
Ability to manage complex, high-pressure program timelines



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in merger/integration programs (highly desirable)
Familiarity with Testing-as-a-Service (TaaS) models
Experience in semiconductor or manufacturing industry
Knowledge of SOX controls and audit validation processes



Key Success Metrics

On-time completion of SIT, UAT, and readiness cycles
Achievement of defined pass rates and defect thresholds
Full requirements traceability and coverage
Successful UAT sign-off and deployment readiness
Quality of reporting and stakeholder alignment

jobs.title: PLC Programmer
jobs.description:
Position: PLC Programmer 
Location: Houston, TX (Onsite)
Exp: 4-10 Yrs
Duration: 12+ months
15% travel required
 
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled PLC Programmer with strong experience in Allen-Bradley (Rockwell Automation) systems to support on-site automation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining PLC programs, ensuring efficient operation of industrial systems, and supporting commissioning activities.
Key Responsibilities

Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC programs using Allen-Bradley platforms (ControlLogix, CompactLogix, MicroLogix)
Configure and maintain HMI/SCADA systems (FactoryTalk View or equivalent)
Perform on-site commissioning, startup, and testing of automation systems
Debug and resolve issues related to PLC logic, I/O systems, and communication networks
Integrate PLCs with field devices such as transmitters, switches, valves, motors, VFDs, and actuators
Work with industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, DeviceNet, Modbus)
Read and interpret electrical schematics, P&IDs, and control system documentation
Collaborate with engineering, maintenance, and operations teams over calls, zoom and in-person meetings.
Ensure compliance with safety standards and industry’s best practices
Provide documentation, including technical reports, program backups, and change logs

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or Associate degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or related field
3+ years of hands-on experience with Allen-Bradley PLC programming
Strong knowledge of RSLogix 500 / Studio 5000 (Logix Designer)
Experience with HMI/SCADA development (FactoryTalk preferred)
Solid understanding of industrial automation systems and control theory
Ability to work on-site independently and handle troubleshooting under pressure
Travel to sites and stay to complete the work.
Familiarity with industrial networking and system integration

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Safety PLC systems
Prior experience in industries such as manufacturing, oil & gas, energy, or automotive
Rockwell Automation certification is additional preference

Key Skills

PLC Programming (Allen-Bradley)
Troubleshooting & Debugging
Industrial Automation Systems
Communication Protocols
Electrical & Controls Engineering
Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills
Strong Communication and Documentation Skills

Work Environment

Primarily on-site work at industrial facilities including plant/factory environments
May require travel, extended hours, or weekend work during commissioning phases
15% of travel

jobs.title: IN-DOH-Oral Health Educator
jobs.description:
The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. Oral Health Educator Job Description: Overview:\u2028The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. This position will focus on equipping Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), school nurses, educators, children and families, and community partners with the knowledge and skills needed to support oral hygiene practices, preventive care, and improved oral health outcomes. Responsibilities: ● Training & Education: Develop and deliver tailored workshops, and training sessions for CNAs, school nurses, early learning centers, and community partners on oral health best practices. ● Resource Development: Create and distribute educational materials such as guides, checklists, pamphlets, posters, videos, and digital content tailored to skilled nursing facilities, school settings, and families. ● Collaboration: Work closely with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) leadership, school administrators, healthcare professionals, and community organizations to align oral health education with patient care protocols, school health needs, and community-based initiatives. ● Oral Health Advocacy: Promote the importance of oral health in overall health, especially for elderly residents, chronically ill patients, children, and vulnerable populations. ● Support & Guidance: Serve as a resource to CNAs, school nurses, educators, and community partners by providing ongoing support, answering questions, and offering solutions to oral health challenges. ● Outreach & Events: Support planning, coordination, and participation in community outreach events, health fairs, school-based programs, and public health campaigns to expand oral health awareness and access. ● Program Support: Assist with program planning, preparation and distribution of oral health education materials, grant proposals, budgets, data collection, and reporting. ● Evaluation: Monitor and assess the impact of educational programs and outreach activities and recommend improvements to enhance care delivery, school-based prevention, and community engagement. Qualifications: ● Bachelor’s degree or certification in Dental Hygiene, Public Health, Education, or a related field. ● Experience delivering health education or training programs, preferably in school, healthcare, long-term care, or community settings. ● Knowledge of oral hygiene practices, common dental conditions, preventive care strategies, and behavior change techniques. ● Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage CNAs, school nurses, healthcare teams, educators, families, and community partners. ● Ability to develop accessible, engaging, and culturally appropriate educational materials. ● Familiarity with skilled nursing facility workflows, school health programs, and public health outreach preferred. ● Relevant background in public health, data management, program evaluation, and grant writing preferred. jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Technical Project Manager (ISV / Techno-Functional PM)
jobs.description:
Role: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Technical Project Manager (ISV / Techno-Functional PM)
Location: Remote
 
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Project Manager with deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM (CE) and Finance & Operations (F&O) to lead large-scale, enterprise transformation programs. This role is suited for a technically strong delivery leader who has worked in complex SI-led implementations, where multiple large ISVs and third-party platforms are integrated into the core D365 landscape. The individual will play a critical role in governing multi-vendor delivery, managing 3- 6 ISV dependencies, and ensuring seamless integration across the ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong technical acumen, integration expertise, and program leadership with the ability to drive alignment across clients, system integrators, ISVs, and internal delivery teams.
 
Key Responsibilities
1. Program & Delivery Leadership (SI-Led D365 Programs)
Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale Dynamics 365 CRM and F&O implementations acting as the technical PM within SI-driven programs
Own delivery governance across multiple workstreams including CRM, ERP, integrations, ISVs, and data migration
Drive program planning, execution, risk mitigation, and dependency management across global teams
Lead steering committees, executive reporting, and escalation management
Ensure delivery adherence to scope, timelines, budget, and quality benchmarks
 
2. ISV Ecosystem & Multi-Vendor Management (Critical)
Manage a complex ISV ecosystem forming part of the core D365 solution landscape, including but not limited to: 
SPS Commerce or TruCommerce (EDI / supply chain integrations)
Vertex (indirect tax engine)
SK Soft / SK Global (financial automation)
ZINFI (PRM / partner management)
Windchill / Bluestar PLM (PLM integrations)
Deel (HR / workforce integrations)
DHL/FedEx 4PL
Other logistics, payments, and domain-specific ISVs
Establish clear ownership models, SLAs, and accountability across ISVs and vendors
Drive integration alignment and delivery orchestration between ISVs and core D365 SI teams
Manage cross-ISV dependencies, timelines, and release coordination
Resolve cross-vendor conflicts, integration failures, and delivery risks
Ensure ISV solutions align with enterprise architecture, compliance, and business process goals
 
3. Integration & Technical Leadership
Govern complex integrations across: 
D365 CRM (CE) and F&O
External ISVs and SaaS platforms
Enterprise applications (ERP, PLM, HR, eCommerce, WMS, TMS, banking, etc.)
Define and oversee integration architecture, patterns, and data flow strategies
Lead implementation of: 
API-based integrations (REST/SOAP)
Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Data Factory)
Middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, etc.)
Drive data migration, interface design, and integration testing strategy
 
4. Techno-Functional Coordination
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and integration workstreams
Facilitate design workshops, architecture discussions, and solution validation sessions
Partner closely with: 
Solution architects
Technical leads
Functional consultants
Oversee SIT, UAT, deployment, and hypercare activities
Manage change control, release planning, and environment strategy
 
5. Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management
Act as the single point of accountability across business, SI, ISVs, and Microsoft stakeholders
Proactively manage: 
Integration risks
ISV dependencies and readiness
Multi-vendor delivery challenges
Drive structured governance (RAID logs, KPIs, dashboards, release governance)
Ensure compliance with security, data governance, and regulatory standards
 
Required Qualifications
10+ years of Project/Program Management experience in enterprise technology programs
7+ years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM (CE) and F&O implementations
Proven experience working in System Integrator-led delivery models
Strong experience managing multiple enterprise ISVs within a D365 ecosystem (e.g., SPS Commerce, Vertex, ZINFI, PLM, tax, EDI, HR systems)
Solid technical understanding of: 
D365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing)
D365 F&O / Supply Chain / Finance
Dataverse and Power Platform
Hands-on knowledge of: 
API integrations (REST/SOAP)
Azure Integration Services
Middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic)
Data migration frameworks
Experience with Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models
Strong vendor, stakeholder, and risk management capabilities
 
Preferred Qualifications
Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications (CE / F&O / Power Platform)
PMP / PRINCE2 / Scrum certifications
Experience in large global transformation programs (multi-country / multi-ISV rollouts)
Domain experience in Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, or Supply Chain
Familiarity with: 
Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines
DevSecOps and release management practices
Experience working with Microsoft FastTrack and partner ecosystem
 
Key Skills
D365 CRM & F&O Delivery Leadership
ISV Ecosystem Management (EDI, Tax, PLM, PRM, HR platforms)
SI & Multi-Vendor Program Governance
Enterprise Integration Architecture
Azure Integration Services & API Management
Cross-Functional Global Delivery Leadership
Risk, Dependency & Escalation Management
Data Migration & Release Management
 
Success Profile
The ideal candidate is a technically grounded program leader with proven experience delivering complex D365 CRM + F&O programs involving multiple critical ISVs such as SPS Commerce, Vertex, ZINFI, PLM, and HR integrations.
They bring strong technical depth, vendor orchestration capability, and governance discipline, with the ability to manage large SI-driven programs, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure seamless integration across a highly complex enterprise ecosystem.
